matrix.description: 默认环境，不加载额外插件，用于观察原生 DSH 能力。

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=pwd; ls -a; git status 2>&1 | head -20; git worktree list 2>&1

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=git --version; git config user.email; git config user.name

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=git add README.md && git commit -q -m "chore: initial commit" && git clone -q . isolated-checkout && cd isolated-checkout && git log --oneline && git remote -v && ls -a

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd isolated-checkout && git remote remove origin && git remote -v && git status

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd isolated-checkout && git add README.md && git commit -q -m "docs: note isolated checkout" && git log --oneline && git diff main --stat 2>/dev/null; cd .. && git status --short
